# World Maritime Day Casts a Blue Glow Across Carnival Corporation


Sep 24, 2026


Share


For one night, Carnival Corporation’s landmarks traded their usual look for something a little more maritime.


The whale-tail funnel at Doral headquarters, Palazzo Costa in Genoa and the CSMART training facility in Almere all glowed blue for World Maritime Day, joining a global display recognizing the people and purpose that power the maritime industry.


Separated by thousands of miles but united by a shared commitment to excellence, the three locations lit up the night sky in support of the annual observance. This year’s theme, “From Policy to Practice: Powering Maritime Excellence,” highlights the importance of turning high standards into action across the maritime sector.


From ships at sea to teams working ashore, World Maritime Day celebrates the expertise, innovation and dedication that keep the industry moving forward.
